dedupe_keys.name: 2023 ieee grss data fusion contest large scale fine grained building classification dfc23

description: DFC23 is a benchmark of satellite images with building footprints labelled by fine-grained roof type, released for the 2023 Data Fusion Contest of the IEEE Geoscience and Remote Sensing Society. It was organised by the Society's Image Analysis and Data Fusion Technical Committee with the Aerospace Information Research Institute of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, the Universität der Bundeswehr München and GEOVIS Earth Technology, to push building extraction and 3D reconstruction towards semantic urban models that know roof types. The DataCite record describes a large-scale, multi-modal benchmark of buildings in many cities worldwide, published by IEEE DataPort in 2022. Access: download from the IEEE DataPort competition page after free registration. Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; free. Caveats: this is a machine-learning benchmark, so labels cover the contest cities only and roof classes follow the contest scheme; details of cities and splits are on the competition page. Simulation uses: training and testing roof-type classifiers that feed building exposure models (roof shape drives wind and snow vulnerability) and LoD2-style city models for digital twins. Related records: the BIO LoD3 building point cloud benchmark and GlobalBuildingAtlas.
